name: 咚咚 · 鼓点团子
prompt: One original fantasy rhythm creature, a very chubby apricot dumpling-shaped plush with a wide pear body, tiny arms held apart and two oversized oval feet. No animal ears: three soft rounded drumstick-shaped tufts rise from its head. Cream oval belly with three terracotta embroidered rhythm dots. Two small glossy black eyes far apart, rosy cheeks, tiny curved smile. Dense soft short-pile faux fur, subtle stitched seams, matte velvety fabric. Standing upright, neutral full body, front facing, all sides finished, game collectible. Simple clean silhouette, no ground, background, pedestal, letters, accessories. An invented music creature, not an animal or existing branded toy.
